segmentler.metin: The Lower Van Norman Dam nearly failed in the San Fernando earthquake.
It took only earthquake shaking liquefying the dam's fill.
So how could earthquake shaking liquefying the dam's fill do this?
The answer is liquefaction of hydraulic fill causing a landslide that took part of the crest — and it is why seismic safety of embankment dams was transformed.
